product_analysis_script = """
import openpyxl
from collections import Counter

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header = list(rows[0])
data = rows[1:]

# Column indices
status_idx = header.index('Status')
items_idx = header.index('Items')
total_idx = header.index('Total Paid')
customer_idx = header.index('Customer')
date_idx = header.index('Date')

# --- Status breakdown ---
confirmed = [r for r in data if r[status_idx] == 'confirmed']
cancelled = [r for r in data if r[status_idx] == 'cancelled']

print("=== STATUS BREAKDOWN ===")
print(f"Confirmed: {len(confirmed)} orders")
print(f"Cancelled: {len(cancelled)} orders")
print()

# --- Revenue analysis (confirmed only) ---
confirmed_totals = [float(r[total_idx]) for r in confirmed]
cancelled_totals = [float(r[total_idx]) for r in cancelled]
all_totals = [float(r[total_idx]) for r in data]

print("=== REVENUE ANALYSIS ===")
print(f"Total revenue (all orders): ${sum(all_totals):.2f}")
print(f"Confirmed revenue: ${sum(confirmed_totals):.2f}")
print(f"Cancelled/lost revenue: ${sum(cancelled_totals):.2f}")
print(f"Average order (confirmed): ${sum(confirmed_totals)/len(confirmed_totals):.2f}")
print(f"Min order (confirmed): ${min(confirmed_totals):.2f}")
print(f"Max order (confirmed): ${max(confirmed_totals):.2f}")
print()

# --- Individual product frequency ---
product_counter = Counter()
product_counter_confirmed = Counter()
for r in data:
    items = [item.strip() for item in str(r[items_idx]).split(',')]
    for item in items:
        product_counter[item] += 1
    if r[status_idx] == 'confirmed':
        for item in items:
            product_counter_confirmed[item] += 1

print("=== INDIVIDUAL PRODUCT FREQUENCY (ALL ORDERS) ===")
for prod, cnt in product_counter.most_common():
    print(f"  {prod}: {cnt}")
print()

print("=== INDIVIDUAL PRODUCT FREQUENCY (CONFIRMED ONLY) ===")
for prod, cnt in product_counter_confirmed.most_common():
    print(f"  {prod}: {cnt}")
print()

# --- Customer spending (confirmed orders) ---
customer_spend = {}
customer_order_count = {}
for r in confirmed:
    cust = r[customer_idx]
    amt = float(r[total_idx])
    customer_spend[cust] = customer_spend.get(cust, 0) + amt
    customer_order_count[cust] = customer_order_count.get(cust, 0) + 1

print("=== CUSTOMER SPENDING (CONFIRMED ORDERS) ===")
sorted_customers = sorted(customer_spend.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
for cust, spend in sorted_customers:
    orders = customer_order_count[cust]
    avg = spend / orders
    print(f"  {cust}: ${spend:.2f} ({orders} orders, avg ${avg:.2f})")
print()

# --- Cancelled orders detail ---
print("=== CANCELLED ORDERS ===")
for r in cancelled:
    print(f"  {r[0]} | {r[customer_idx]} | {r[items_idx]} | ${float(r[total_idx]):.2f}")
print()

# --- Items per order distribution ---
items_per_order = []
for r in data:
    items = [item.strip() for item in str(r[items_idx]).split(',')]
    items_per_order.append(len(items))

print("=== ITEMS PER ORDER DISTRIBUTION ===")
item_dist = Counter(items_per_order)
for count in sorted(item_dist.keys()):
    print(f"  {count} item(s): {item_dist[count]} orders")
print(f"  Average items per order: {sum(items_per_order)/len(items_per_order):.2f}")
"""
await write_file("./product_analysis.py", product_analysis_script)
print("Script written")

product_result = await run_command("python ./product_analysis.py")
print(product_result)
